note: ZCode adaptation of the tea-rags plugin. Eval cases are imported from the Claude Code plugin benchmarks (search-cascade, working-tree-injection, addressing-consistency, index-lag-overlay) with ZCode dialect deltas (no Grep/Glob tool: Bash rg channel; no model-side resource tool: tea-rags resource CLI; no SubagentStart: subagent dispatch hook), plus new cases covering exactly those deltas. Paper-style tool-selection eval (optimize-skill Phase 2 methodology): one ZCode subagent per suite per arm reads the byte-exact rendered artifact the shipped hook injects and an expectation-free case file, then states its first tool call per case. No tools executed.
plugin_version: tea-rags 0.55.8 (plugins/), rendered harness/zcode commit pending first commit

method.with_injection: actor context = the byte-exact artifact the shipped zcode hook injects (rules/core.md via session-rules.sh; scripts/subagent-block.txt via subagent-context.sh; scripts/turn-routing.txt via turn-routing.sh) + a ZCode-shaped tool list (Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Agent, Skill, AskUserQuestion, mcp__tea-rags__*), then the case file
method.no_rule: same actor prompt, artifacts removed (tool list + case file only)
method.actor: ZCode Agent-tool subagent (general-purpose), one per suite per arm, one run per case
method.grading: first stated tool call vs expected/not; controls must stay correct in both arms

grading_notes: ZB2/ZB5 accept hybrid_search with metaOnly:true or a slim fields list, AND the shipped block's caller route (find_symbol to resolve the id, then get_callers — 'how X works / who calls X → get_callees/get_callers(symbolId:<id>, depth: 2)' plus the trailing 'every caller → get_callers + it' line); the working-tree-injection iteration-4 answer (hybrid_search metaOnly) is the token-economy preference of that benchmark's opus actor, not a contract the current block text pins. ZA3 accepts Bash rg literal optionally beside get_callers (codegraph on), never semantic_search as the sweep. ZA5 accepts find_symbol-to-resolve-ids before trace_path (the core's own 'A→B → find_symbol ids → trace_path' row). ZC2 accepts the CLI call without an explicit --path (the CLI defaults to cwd). ZC5 accepts a filename inventory before the Read when the path is treated as unknown (the core's '-l filenames first for config' line). ZC6 accepts the bare or qualified skill name; the plugin-shipped form is tea-rags:bug-hunt.
